description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Objective Partners is recruiting for an unnamed quantitative trading firm. The Software Engineer will design, profile, and optimize low-latency distributed infrastructure, including execution platforms, market data engines, and high-throughput data processing systems.
C++ Software Engineer building low-latency execution platforms and market data engines, optimizing performance and integrating FPGA/ASIC acceleration

Responsibilities:
• Design, build, and enhance resilient, ultra-low-latency execution platforms and market data engines spanning diverse asset classes
• Execute deep-level performance profiling and C++ code optimizations to minimize latency and maximize throughput across production environments
• Engineer fault-tolerant architecture capable of WAN packet prioritization, graceful hardware failover, and continuous live operation
• Develop low-level software interfaces and integrations for specialized hardware acceleration, including FPGAs and custom ASICs
• Maintain scalable back-end infrastructure supporting distributed file systems, high-volume research workflows, and direct market access

Requirements:
• At least 1 year of professional software engineering experience delivering production C++ applications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline
• Advanced proficiency in C++ with strong hands-on daily application
• Solid understanding of Linux/UNIX operating system internals, CPU performance tuning, memory architecture, and network communication protocols (TCP/UDP)
• Excellent analytical, architectural design, and system debugging skills

Preferred:
• Proven track record of high technical impact, code quality, and technical mentorship
• Demonstrated ability to navigate trade-offs between high-level abstractions and low-level algorithmic optimizations
• Experience developing software that interfaces directly with low-latency network hardware or custom processors
